Perfect! I found the complete i18n translation resources for the sketchpad toolbar. Here's the comprehensive breakdown:

## Translation Resource Location

**Primary File:** [elements/ui/index.tsx](elements/ui/index.tsx#L142)

This file contains the `elementUiTranslationBundles` object that defines all translations with support for English (en) and German (de) locales.

## Translation Bundle Structure

The translations are defined as a JSON structure with English at [line 5007](elements/ui/index.tsx#L5007) and German starting at [line 142](elements/ui/index.tsx#L142).

### English (en) - Toolbar Parent Translations
**Location:** [elements/ui/index.tsx](elements/ui/index.tsx#L9731-L9741)

```
"toolbar": {
  "parent": {
    "hand": "Hand",
    "selection": "Selection",
    "lasso": "Lasso",
    "filter": "Filter",
    "create": "Create",
    "view": "View",
    "actions": "Actions",
    "settings": "Settings"
  }
}
```

### German (de) - Toolbar Parent Translations  
**Location:** [elements/ui/index.tsx](elements/ui/index.tsx#L4819-L4848)

```
"toolbar": {
  "parent": {
    "selection": { "label": { "normal": "Auswahl", "beginner": "Auswahl" } },
    "hand": { "label": { "normal": "Hand", "beginner": "Hand" } },
    "lasso": { "label": { "normal": "Lasso", "beginner": "Lasso" } },
    "filter": { "label": { "normal": "Filter", "beginner": "Filter" } },
    "create": { "label": { "normal": "Erstellen", "beginner": "Erstellen" } },
    "view": { "label": { "normal": "Ansicht", "beginner": "Ansicht" } },
    "actions": { "label": { "normal": "Aktionen", "beginner": "Aktionen" } },
    "settings": { "label": { "normal": "Einstellungen", "beginner": "Einstellungen" } }
  }
}
```

## How Translations Are Used

The sketchpad uses `useLabel()` hook from the UI library to resolve these keys:

**Usage in Sketchpad:** [compose/sketchpad/index.tsx](compose/sketchpad/index.tsx#L25008)

```typescript
text={resolveTranslationLabel(i18n.t(`compose.sketchpad.toolbar.parent.${groupId}`))}
```

## i18next Initialization

**Location:** [elements/ui/index.tsx](elements/ui/index.tsx#L9886-9919)

The `initializeElementUiI18n()` function initializes i18next with:
- Resources from `elementUiTranslationBundles`
- Fallback language: "en"
- Supported languages: ["en", "de"]
- Exported as: `elementUiI18n`

This is the single source of truth for all sketchpad translations, supporting both expertise levels (beginner, normal) in the German bundle and providing clean string values in the English bundle.
